title: Deals: Pixel 11 lineup goes on sale, latest Galaxy phones get discounts
description: The Google Pixel 11 series, which went up for pre-order last week, is now officially available for purchase on Amazon UK. Alongside the Pixel phones, Samsung’s latest Galaxy foldables and the Galaxy S26 series have received price cuts. While the Google Pixel 11 lineup hasn’t received any price cut, users are eligible for an added trade-in bonus when exchanging a compatible used phone. description: According to a new rumor from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, after having launched quite a few larger tablets, iQOO is getting ready to enter the small tablet space, directly competing with the RedMagic Astra 2, which was released back in June. The iQOO tablet is rumored to have an 8.8-inch screen with an "ultra-high" refresh rate and narrow bezels on all four sides, a metal frame, and a built-in cooling fan. title: vivo V70 Lite 4G arrives with 8,100mAh battery and IP69 rating
description: The vivo V70 Lite was announced back in June, and its 4G counterpart has not been listed across several markets in Eurasia. As the name implies, this device features a 4G chipset – specifically Unisoc’s T7300. It is paired with 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 128/256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. The phone also brings an 8,100mAh battery with support for 44W wired charging. V70 Lite 4G is built around a 6.83-inch AMOLED featuring 1,260 x 2,800px resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It also features an optical fingerprint scanner and a 32MP front-facing camera. The back houses a 50MP main cam and a 2MP...

title: Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max India launch date leaks along with pricing details
description: The Redmi Note 17 series is getting its global launch next week, but that won't include India. Over there, the Redmi Note 17 is already official, while today new details about the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max have surfaced. According to a new report, the two Pro devices will be made official for India on September 15. The Pro is said to have a 9,000 mAh battery just like its Chinese counterpart, while the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max will have a 10,000 mAh battery and will be powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 SoC. This device will feature a 6.8-inch OLED screen with a 120Hz...

title: Poco X8 and X8 Power marketing materials leak
description: A few hours ago a rumor claimed Poco would soon launch the X8 Power with a 10,000 mAh battery. Now a different tipster on X has shared some purported marketing materials for both the X8 Power as well as the long-awaited X8. We'll just say it outright: these seem to be rebrand jobs. Specifically, the X8 appears to be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro, and the X8 Power may be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro Max. There are some very slight differences, but not many. According to these slides, the X8 has a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen with 3,500-nit peak brightness and Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on...

title: Here's how much you'll pay if you break the Honor Robot Phone's gimbal camera
description: Honor's Robot Phone was finally made official last week after many months of teasers and showcases. It's definitely a unique device, with its integrated gimbal camera, even if it's not actually a robot. That gimbal camera, though, contains a lot of moving parts, so if you drop the phone while it's out, you might damage it. In that case, you will have to pay a whopping CNY 3,079 ($457) to replace it. description: Last month, Samsung acknowledged reports that the Galaxy S26 Ultra display can have a red tint under certain conditions and promised a fix for it – the company blamed it on a software issue, not a hardware one. Said fix is coming by the end of the month, according to Samsung’s customer support team in Korea. One user on the Samsung Community forum posted a screenshot of a conversation with support, which claims that the fix is currently being evaluated by the verification department. title: RayNeo unveils productivity-focused iO glasses and multimedia-focused GT glasses
description: RayNeo, one of the top AR smart glasses companies out there (with 23.7% market share, based on Counterpoint data for Q1 2026), unveiled two new product lines – the iO and the GT series. The former focuses on “glanceable” ambient intelligence, the latter is all-in on multimedia (games and movies). The RayNeo iO Smart Glasses have a lightweight build for all-day wear. They weigh 33g and have an even 50:50 weight distribution between the front and the back. description: The European Commission may be happy with Apple’s new app store rules, but Epic Games sure isn’t. The Fortnite developer and proprietor of one of the largest game stores thinks that Apple’s changes still violate the Digital Markets Act. description: The Poco X8 series currently comprises the X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max, with a base X8 model also rumored to be in the works. Now, a new leak claims that Poco is preparing to launch an X8 Power variant as well. According to a tipster, the Poco X8 Power could debut soon with a massive 10,000mAh battery. The tipster has also shared the phone's full specifications, suggesting that it could be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro Max, which is set to launch next week. description: Now that we've welcomed the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 to the office, we can say we've completed the set. And it's a very pink and purple set indeed. We've got the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra reviews over here if you want to check those out, but now let's have a look at the Z Flip8. The short version is this: Galaxy Z Flip8 is a Galaxy Z Flip7 with a newer chipset and a pink color. title: Honor Turbo 5G silently unveiled
description: Following a recent listing on AliExpress, Honor Turbo 5G is now official. The official listing on Honor Eurasia confirms the previously leaked specs which include the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset, a 6.79-inch AMOLED (FHD+120Hz), an 8,560 mAh battery and IP69 ingress protection. The phone ships with MagicOS 10 based on Android 16 and also features a 50MP main cam and a 5MP ultrawide lens. It is available in black, green and orange colors and starts at RUB 33,990 ($411) in Russia.

title: vivo V80 Lite with 10,000mAh battery to debut on September 3
description: The vivo V80 Lite appeared on an Indian retailer’s Instagram page earlier this week, hinting at an imminent launch. Now, the official vivo Malaysia website has confirmed the phone’s launch, albeit with a different design. vivo Malaysia has announced that the V80 Lite 5G will launch in the country on September 3. The company has also confirmed that the phone will pack a 10,000mAh battery. The company has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone. title: Poco M8x arrives with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, a 120Hz display, and a 7,900 mAh battery
description: Poco today unveiled the Poco M8x as the newest member of its M8 series. The Poco M8x is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, making it India's first smartphone to have that chip at the helm. It has up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 storage, expandable via a microSD card. On the software side, the M8x runs Android 16-based HyperOS 3, with Poco promising four generations of Android OS upgrades and six years of security updates. title: OnePlus tipped to launch a new budget phone in India
description: After announcing its exit from North America and Europe, OnePlus reaffirmed its commitment to India and said it would continue launching new smartphones in the country. Following the OnePlus N6x launch last month, a new rumor now claims that the company is preparing to unveil another budget phone soon. Tipster Yogesh Brar claimed in a post on X that OnePlus is planning to launch a new budget smartphone in India. The handset is reportedly set to be a 4G-only device. title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro's India launch timeframe announced, color options revealed
description: The Infinix Hot 70 Pro, unveiled last month, will debut in India soon. Infinix hasn't revealed the Hot 70 Pro's India launch date yet, but said it will arrive in India in the first week of September. Infinix also confirmed that the Hot 70 Pro will be sold through Flipkart in India and will come in four colors - Mirage Green, Dive Blue, Silk Glow Purple, and Thermo Orange. The Infinix Hot 70 Pro's Thermo Orange model features a back panel that changes color with temperature, while Mirage Green has a finish that "transforms under nighttime conditions." description: Ever since Google released Android 17, you may have been wondering when Nothing will release its own interpretation of the new OS. Well, we are getting closer. The company has just announced that Nothing OS 5.0, which will be based on Android 17, is "coming soon". But wait, there's more. description: The Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra are coming soon, it seems, with the number of leaks about them increasing in the past week. Now, the Ultra appears to have run Geekbench 7, achieving a single-core score of 2,980 and a multi-core score of 10,030. It's powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired in the specific prototype which ran the benchmark with 16GB of RAM, but of course we assume other memory options will be available upon launch.
